about: Homer Sleeping Peacefully is a Simpsons still of Homer tucked deep into bed, buried under a huge red blanket with only the top of his head showing between big puffy blue pillows, eyes closed and completely at peace. It is the image of total calm and zero worries, usually because the problem is someone else's, or because he has not found out about it yet.
usage:
Top box: the reason you can sleep so well. Bottom box: optional, for the irony that is coming, or leave it empty.

It works for smug peace of mind: having saved the file, having finished the assignment early, or simply not knowing what is about to happen. Pairing it with a problem you are cheerfully unaware of makes it funnier.
ideas: me sleeping knowing I saved the file
me after turning off work notifications
the on-call engineer's phone on silent
me after submitting the assignment early
me with the group project done
